__patches.replace: .nav .more > .chip { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; width: 100%; min-height: 48px; font-size: 16px; }
.more .pop-in { box-shadow: none; border: 0; border-left: 2px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; padding: 4px 0 4px 8px; margin: 8px 0 4px 14px; min-width: 0; }

__patches.find: function set(o) { h.classList.toggle('open', o); b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', o ? 'true' : 'false'); b.textContent = o ? 'Close' : 'Menu'; }
